Even sitting still in central Europe, Earth's spin carries you at about 1,076 km/h, Earth's orbit at about 107,000 km/h (29.8 km/s), and the Sun carries us around the Milky Way at about 720,000 km/h. Each speed is measured relative to a different centre.

Sources:
NASA NSSDCA Planetary Fact Sheet: https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/factsheet/
NASA NSSDCA Earth Fact Sheet: https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/factsheet/earthfact.html
NASA Science, Sun facts: https://science.nasa.gov/sun/facts/

Images: NASA / JSC (Blue Marble), NASA / JPL-Caltech (Spitzer). Narration uses a synthetic voice.
